scientific.integrity: Generator matrices were read from the primary source; all 16 words of each code were independently enumerated and the resulting spectra were cross-checked from the binary residue supports.
scientific.limitations: Exact only for the three l2-optimal free [8,2,4] E-codes in Table 10; no claim that weight spectrum completely classifies arbitrary E-codes.

title: Weight spectra separate the three optimal free length-eight rank-two codes over E
